summary: Additional media tests were added to catch regressions in color rendering, audio time-stretching, and error handling: explicit-color-test videos and AV1 snapshot updates improve cross-platform color checks, a media-gpu mochitest was added for GPU sanity, there’s a crashtest for multi-channel audio through the SoundTouch time-stretcher, and a test ensuring media load-error messages are redacted across redirects (protecting privacy). These broadened tests help keep rendering and error-reporting consistent across platforms.
